title: Before a car leaves your bay
facts: Ten checks; lugs torqued by hand with a torque wrench; brake slides cleaned and lubricated (slot 27 skips this: S6).
The job clock is stopped per job (ERP time_entry).

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Wheels off today? Torque the lugs with the torque wrench, by hand, to the spec. Not the gun.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Brake job? Pump the pedal before you move the car. Clean and lube the slides. Check the fluid level.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Caps on: oil, coolant, brake fluid, washer. Dipstick in.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Nothing left under the hood. Count your tools.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Start it, look underneath for drips.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Drive it round the building at least. Brakes, steering, suspension and anything that made a noise gets a real road test.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Reset the oil light. Set the tire pressures to the door sticker.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Old parts in the box if the order says the customer wants them.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Wipe the wheel, the shifter and the door handle. Take the seat cover and mat out.

list_items.section: Before a car leaves your bay
list_items.item: Stop your job clock. Write what you did and what you saw on the order.
